Use case: illustration-story. Asset: LearnBangla illustrated reading. Collection: My Animals. Chapter: Animals at home.
PRIMARY SCENE TO ILLUSTRATE: The dog runs.
Context only (do not cram all events into image): A dog and a cat.

Warm, expressive, child-friendly. Where a girl is mentioned, keep Tara consistent: Bengali girl about 7, brown skin, black hair in two braids, mustard yellow floral dress; mother cream floral sari, dark green blouse; father cream panjabi, dark hair and short beard; grandfather white beard, white kurta and checked lungi. Only include characters needed by the specific reading. A Rainy Day uses teal dress, red leggings and yellow rain boots.
One full-bleed landscape 3:2 illustration, 1536x1024. Detailed hand-painted gouache with tactile brushwork, natural proportions, luminous light, warm ochre, terracotta and teal, lush Bengali greenery. Match a polished illustrated Bengali reading collection. No text, lettering, numbers, speech bubbles, watermark, borders, collage or multiple panels. One clear focal scene, readable at phone size. Avoid generic clipart or emoji style.
